name: Can I paint directly over Level 5 drywall without priming?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint directly over Level 5 drywall without priming?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, even with a Level 5 finish, it is crucial to prime the surface before painting. While Level 5 provides a perfectly smooth and uniform substrate, primer serves several essential functions that paint alone cannot achieve. Primer helps seal the surface, improving paint adhesion and preventing the paint from being absorbed unevenly. It also ensures consistent sheen and color development of the topcoat. Skipping primer, even on a Level 5 surface, can lead to blotchiness, uneven color, and reduced durability of the paint finish, compromising the investment in the high-quality drywall work.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, priming is still essential after Level 5 drywall finishing to ensure proper paint adhesion, consistent sheen, and even color.
